text: This solution, PCRIC Coral Reef Parametric Insurance Policy for Northern Lau, Fiji addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Fiji between Pacific Catastrophe Risk Insurance Company (PCRIC), Vatuvara Foundation (VVF), WTW, Reask, Insurance Holdings (Pacific) Pte Ltd., and BHP. The program was implemented in 2024 and focuses on collaboration, leveraging tech, and raising awareness.
